# CordisX Documentation

This entry routes agents to CordisX's owning documentation. It is a navigation
layer, not another implementation or copy of the Host and plugin manuals.

## Reading Order

1. For first-time product setup, read [CordisX adoption](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cordisx/cordisx/main/llms.txt).
   Skip setup already completed in this task.
2. For a specific question, choose the smallest relevant entry in [the Skill and documentation index](skills/index.md).
3. Use the installed `cordisx` entry when available. It selects standard Docs,
   user-experience Q&A, or Plugin Dev as needed. Reading this portal does not
   require installing Skills; startup manages the Skills bundled by that Host
   release. [Skill availability](.agents/docs/install-docs-skill.md) covers
   older releases and optional standalone use.

Resolve relative links against this document's URL. Read only the selected topic
and its required references; do not crawl every linked page or loop back through
completed prerequisites. Read `SKILL.md` directly when persistent installation
is not wanted or the agent cannot install skills.

## Boundary

Documentation discovery does not install plugins, launch Apps, grant permissions,
or log into services. Follow the user's request and the target tool's permissions.
This public portal does not contain private source addresses or credentials.
Product commands and compatibility facts belong to their linked owners. Check
the installed release's help/docs if current `main` differs from that release.
Keep user-facing requirements separate from repository maintenance conventions.
Practical experience belongs in Q&A, with its context and applicable limits;
standard documentation remains authoritative for product behavior.
